risks.proof: A photo of the needle plate and the underside of the presser foot.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a new needle and presser foot

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential accessories like the bobbin case or bobbin.
risks.proof: A photo showing the bobbin area and the bobbin case.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching a piece of fabric.
Photo of the needle and presser foot.
Photo of the bobbin area and bobbin case.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
